title: Day 23 · Weekend Arrival
caption:
Sunday set. A dusty blue Saylor cable knit, worn long and loose with wide-leg stone Camille trousers, walking beside the Ian Hoodie Set and Ian Pants Set in army, white CARBON Sneakers on both.

Swipe from the golden-hour walk to the armchair and the morning coffee. STRONG runs down one sleeve, BRAVE down the other and the length of one leg, each framed by zip trim, with a drawstring hood, ribbed cuffs and tapered joggers. Then out to the balcony, barefoot, mug in hand, the same set from first light to the last of the sun.

One set for the slow day and the arrival after it.

title: Day 26 · The Cream Puffer
caption:
Rain check. The cream Philip Puffer Coat, worn open with the hood down, over a black Miles knit, dark blue ripped Jase Jeans and white CARBON Sneakers with a black side stripe.

Swipe from the lit steps at dusk to a wet neon street after dark. Rain beads on the quilted shell, the grey-tipped trim frames the collar, and the buttoned flap pockets and black ribbed cuffs keep the cold where it belongs. Down low, the slim, faded denim meets the low-tops mid-splash.

One coat for the steps, the street and the puddle in between.

Arrive Different.

title: Day 28 · Knit and Stone
caption:
Gift season, unwrapped. A black box tied with black satin ribbon, black tissue folded back, and the Tyson Sweater in blue waiting underneath.

Swipe to watch it lift out of the box and into the look. The ribbed roll neck and close-fitting knit, worn with slim stone Colin Evening Pants with a pressed crease and white CARBON Sneakers with a black side stripe. Warm afternoon light, olive trees, one easy outfit for the season of long dinners and late arrivals.

The gift he will wear from the first course to the last toast.

title: Packed for Thanksgiving
caption:
Packed for Thanksgiving. An olive Romeo turtleneck, mid-blue Finn jeans and black and white CARBON Sneakers, folded into a tan leather weekender.

Swipe to watch them come out of the bag and into the travel look. The ribbed roll neck over slim, faded denim, finished with the low-top sneakers for long walks to the gate and the last stretch to the front door.

One outfit, from the flight to the table.
